name: Vicboys
source:
Set in Victorian England, you play as a young woman whose arrival causes a great stir in the village of Vicville.

But the novelty fades eventually, as the townsfolk proceed with their lives - Leaving you to your own. You must try to make a living for yourself, mingle with the citizens and find a way to fit in. Otherwise, you’ll be forced to fight poverty… and loneliness. As a woman from a modest background, you won’t be restrained by the social conventions set by the upper class. But the fear of becoming an old spinster taints us all. As time passes you find your interest piqued by some of Vicville’s prominent bachelors. But who will you pursue?
translation:
故事发生在维多利亚时代的英国。你将扮演一名年轻女子，你的到来在维克维尔村引起巨大轰动。

但新鲜感最终会消退，镇民继续过自己的生活，留下你独自面对一切。你必须努力谋生，与居民交往，找到融入这里的方法。否则，你将被迫与贫困……以及孤独斗争。作为出身普通的女性，你不会受到上流阶层社会规范的束缚。然而，害怕成为年老的未婚女性，是我们共同的阴影。随着时间流逝，你开始对维克维尔一些著名单身汉产生兴趣。你会追求谁？
